title: Custom Skies
description: Change the sun, moon and stars to your liking
body:
## Custom Skies
Custom Skies allows you to change the sun, moon and stars to your liking by customizing it in the config menu

![Moon Big](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/09dde7f34b596af3a24b33fcea732e84cccb6c1a.png)

### Features
- You can change the size, color and brightness of the sun, moon and stars

### Configuration
| Option | Description | Default |
|--------|-------------|---------|
| Size | How big or small should the object be | 100 |
| Brightness | How bright should the object be | 100 |
| Color | What color you want your object to be | #ffffff |

---
You can add this mod to your modpack if you wish!
